interface.signature: say_hello(name: List[str], city: str, state: str) -> str

preconditions.expression: isinstance(name, list) and all(isinstance(n, str) for n in name) and len(name) > 0
preconditions.description: name is a non-empty list of strings

postconditions.description: the output is a formatted greeting string with the full name, city, and state
